weighting: Within landscape equal positions, equal pairs within position; equal landscapes within family and equal families. Family-macro SD ratio and rank are primary; legacy unweighted-landscape means retained for direct prior-study comparison. Stratum cMAE is centered within that stratum/landscape. Controls descriptive only. Ensemble averages endpoint predictions over all five fixed checkpoints.
normalization: All residue stage changes use original-path WT background channel scales, held fixed across conditions. Raw L2 and exact equality retained in restricted checkpoints.
interpretation: Fixed-weight input-alignment intervention; checkpoint training layout is unknown. No outcome-based condition or checkpoint selection.

branch_contributions.interpretation: Discrete eight-state WT/Mut feature interventions; shares describe mutation-response contribution at this fusion interface. Tiny float32 interaction terms are numerical-scale observations.
